title: Varokaa huijausta!
body:
Älkää ladatko koko appia! Ottivat ensin 1€ maksun jonka jälkeen veloittivat kahteen kertaan 28,58€ ja vielä tämän jälkeen 39,99€! Vaikka kuinka valittaisi ja pyytäisi heitä palauttamaan rahat takaisin niin niitä ei saa takaisin! 
 
This app is money scam! Don't use this app because it don't work and also they just charge money from your account multiple times.
Very bad custom service and stupid app anyways!
author: Liinart

title: Total scam!!
body:
Horrible!! Total SCAM!! 

I choose a one-week trial (5+ euros), after which I was supposed to receive a PDF-file of some ADHD report, were they withdrew twice on 60€!! And even if I didn’t want to pay or receive the god damn report they still withdrew the money and didn’t even send it to me. 

And the customer support is impossible, only receiving automatic replys with we have now cancelled your subscription. Thanks but where is the refund for a PDF-report that I never even received?
author: marpet99

title: Messy app, money scam
body: The app is really messy and hard to use with multiply links, and they have made it way too easy to accidentally make purchases within the app! It has way too much everything and at the same time not any real content. And of c they wont give any refunds. Avoid this!
author: nllå

title: Tricks you for payment, does not worth it!
body: The app tricks you with multiple links at the time of signing up so you get to pay an extra month although you wanted to do only a trial. Plus, the features absolutely do NOT worth it.

title: Don't buy!!
body:
Someone here put it well in words: AVOID THIS APP! It's just a “cute UI cash grab”. They won't refund you any money, the purpose of this app, like many other apps these days, is to take your money.

I didn't get any refund which they promised!
